test_OPTIONAL_INTS: test hypothesis strategy that generates lists of 3 to 10 optional integers
test_OPTIONAL_FLOATS: test hypothesis strategy that generates lists of 3 to 10 optional floats
test_DATETIME_IN_PD_TIMESTAMP_RANGE_NO_T: test hypothesis strategy that generates pandas-compatible datetimes within pd.Timestamp.min to pd.Timestamp.max with no timezone
test_YQM_OFFSET: test hypothesis strategy that generates pandas time offset objects like MonthBegin, QuarterEnd, YearEnd
test_OPTIONAL_ONE_OF_ALL: test hypothesis strategy that generates lists of dicts, floats, ints, lists, or text with optional nulls
